question.text: Transfer of securities from one depository to another (inter-depository transfers) during multiple settlements on the same day must be facilitated:

answer.text: Within one hour, and before pay-in for the subsequent settlement begins

explanation.text: The Logic: Depositories shall facilitate inter-depository transfers within one hour and before pay-in for the subsequent settlement begins. The Trap: The source phrasing combines two conditions — within one hour AND before pay-in for the next settlement — so a single-clause timing answer is incomplete. Note: The rule supports same-day multi-settlement scenarios where members may need pay-out securities from one settlement to meet pay-in of the next.
